name: Ontario Library Volunteens and Teen Library Advisory Board
what_you_do: Earn service hours at the library. Short-term Volunteens help for under 20 hours. Long-term Volunteens can stay until 18. The Teen Library Advisory Board plans teen programs and events with staff.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 17. Volunteens must live in Ontario or go to an Ontario school. The Teen Library Advisory Board is for Ontario residents.
duration: Short-term Volunteens: under 20 hours. Long-term Volunteens: until you turn 18. The advisory board meets every two months.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Call the library to ask about openings.
how_to_apply: Call the teen area at the Ovitt library, 909-395-2228. Or call the Lewis branch, 909-395-2272.
notes: Teen Alley at the Ovitt library has teen-only hours Monday to Thursday 3 to 7 pm and Friday 3 to 6 pm. Teen Scene at the Lewis branch is Monday to Thursday 4 to 7 pm. The library also runs Scream Teens, a fall writing contest for teens.
